latestVersion.changelog:
**Major update: Introduces slot-based texture compression options and KTX2 support for Web 3D optimization workflows.**

- Added support for per-slot texture compression: Normal/ORM use UASTC, BaseColor/Emissive use ETC1S, with differentiated resolution and encoding per LOD and slot.
- Exposed user-selectable global texture encoding: choose between WebP (default, simple/fast) and KTX2 (GPU-native, zero CPU decode).
- Updated default parameters to specify slot-resolution mapping, slot-specific compression quality, and detailed KTX2 options.
- Expanded documentation and troubleshooting with slot-based compression rationale, KTX2 configuration guidance, and common pitfalls.
- Clarified manifest outputs and LOD × slot mappings for better front-end integration and lazy loading.
